headline: Growth accelerates on pricing, volume and high-tech
summary_short: Net sales rose 13% to $4,695M with organic growth of 7%, and adjusted EPS grew 5% to $2.18. Ecolab guides 2026 adjusted EPS to $8.10-$8.20.
summary_long: Volume grew 2% and pricing 5%. Global High-Tech grew 63% organically and Life Sciences 17%; Ovivo Electronics and CoolIT added 11 points to Global Water sales. Adjusted operating income rose 14% on strong sales and productivity. Adjusted EPS carried a roughly 10% headwind from CoolIT amortization and financing, and net interest expense rose $70M. Fourth-quarter adjusted EPS is guided to $2.13-$2.23. Reported EPS fell 5% on special charges.
confidence_notes: Adjusted figures are non-GAAP and exclude special gains and charges and discrete tax items. Deltas are the release's own public-currency growth rates. Adjusted gross margin fell 70bp on M&A mix.

drivers.explanation: Organic growth of 7% (2% volume, 5% price) plus acquisitions of Ovivo Electronics and CoolIT.
Strong sales and productivity lifted operating income, but CoolIT acquisition-related amortization and financing costs were an approximately 10% headwind.
Strong sales growth and improved productivity more than offset growth investments and higher commodity costs.
CEO calls the quarter an inflection point, citing accelerating growth in core businesses and growth engines such as Global High-Tech.
